description.value: Sushi Mura is a Vancouver-born Japanese sushi chain that has grown to seven locations across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley since opening in 2012. The menu spans a wide range of Japanese fare — sashimi, nigiri, specialty rolls, noodle bowls, and hot appetizers such as gyoza and takoyaki — with an emphasis on fresh daily-delivered fish. Customer reviews consistently highlight generous portion sizes and friendly service.

The coordinates (49.141, -122.669) place this node in the Langley area, most likely corresponding to Sushi Mura Langley (19979 76 Ave, Langley BC V2Y 3Y2, 604-371-1110), but this cannot be confirmed from OSM data alone. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the website; multiple menu items are labeled 'Veggie', confirming vegetarian options.
